purpose: Frozen teacher-authored continuation probes, assessed after validation selects a checkpoint. This is a narrow language diagnostic, not an assistant qualification exam.
use: Never give these prompts or review answers to the language trainer or use their results to select a checkpoint within this pilot.
novelty: These are separately authored prompts. Individual words or phrases may occur in the public corpus; their absence is not guaranteed.

generation.stop: learned end-of-document token or token budget; preserve raw output

review.readability: 0: mostly gibberish; 1: readable fragments with broken syntax or repetition; 2: at least one grammatical, understandable complete sentence
review.continuity: 0: contradicts or ignores the premise; 1: partly follows it; 2: follows the premise with a plausible continuation
review.record: Store raw text and token IDs, both scores, a brief reason, model/corpus/exam hashes and generation settings. Empty output remains a failure.
review.provisional_gate: For the greedy outputs, at least 18 of 20 score 2 for readability and at least 14 score 2 for continuity. These teacher-chosen pilot thresholds are not a validated benchmark and do not prove assistant reliability.
